Former Synagogue in Meckesheim

Former Synagogue · Meckesheim, Germany

The synagogue in Meckesheim was built around 1830 on Leopoldstraße, serving a small Jewish community that had formed in the area around 1700. As the congregation's numbers declined, it was formally dissolved in October 1937 by order of the Baden state ministry, and the synagogue building was sold before the end of that year. Because it was already in private hands, the building survived the November 1938 pogrom undamaged. It has since been used as a private residence, retaining round-arched architectural features from its original construction.
